text:
deploy-bot: preflight check FAILED for release v3.2.1 -> staging vs prod secret key mismatch detected.

deploy-bot: check: service-credentials/{service-name}
 - staging key: service-token-v2
 - prod key: service-token-v2-BETA
Action recommended: PAUSE release and reconcile secret key naming. Reason: runtime reads exact key name for auth config.

alex: I caught flaky auth errors during staging canary 2. Repro steps below.

alex: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(kubectl get secret svc-creds -o jsonpath='{.data.service-token-v2}' | base64 -d)" https://staging.example.internal/health
Response: 401

priya: is prod actually using v2-BETA suffix? that sounds like an older migration tag.

jamal: checked prod secrets: `kubectl -n prod get secret svc-creds -o yaml` shows `data: service-token-v2-BETA: <redacted>`

mei: looks like a k8s secret rename happened in the rollout of credentials-migration. staging was backfilled with the new key name but prod still has the older suffixed key. mismatch causes the runtime's secret lookup to fail.

sophie: hold the rollout. @alex can you draft the rollback/pin plan? we need a fix within the 1h change window or rollback to previous image.

alex: plan A: backfill prod secret with an alias key `service-token-v2` pointing to same value as `service-token-v2-BETA`. quick command:

```
kubectl -n prod get secret svc-creds -o json | jq '.data["service-token-v2"] = .data["service-token-v2-BETA"]' | kubectl apply -f -
```

This creates a duplicate key; reversible. Ops approval needed.

priya: alternative Plan B: pin canary to image tag `v3.2.0` (previous) until proper migration completed. takes ~5m to cut.

jamal: +1 on pin. we should also add a deploy lint to fail on secret key name differences across envs.

mei: logging only: adding runbook link https://redwood.runbooks/internal/secret-migration

sophie: decision: PAUSE release. Alex please run Plan A if you can get ops approval now; otherwise we'll pin canary to v3.2.0 and reschedule migration to next change window.

alex: requesting ops-approvals channel for prod secret write. pinging @ops-team
deploy-bot: release v3.2.1 has been PAUSED by releasecoord (sophie). Reason: env secret key parity mismatch. next check scheduled in 15m.
